parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
The fruit fly, *Drosophila melanogaster*, usually has red eyes. A gene for eye colour has four alleles: red, apricot, honey and white.

Define the terms *gene* and *allele*.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
• The allele for red eyes, $C^R$, is dominant to the other three alleles.
• The allele for apricot eyes, $C^A$, is dominant to the allele for honey eyes, $C^H$.
• The allele for white eyes, $C^W$, is recessive to the other three alleles.

Construct a genetic diagram to show the genotypes, phenotypes and ratio of the offspring from a cross between a fruit fly with red eyes, $C^RC^H$, and a fruit fly with apricot eyes, $C^AC^W$.
